01

總覽與架構

產品定位、請求流程、串流契約與 Jev 路由

Open Intelligent UI（CopilotKit 的開源專案）是一個把回答變成「可以操作的東西」的聊天介面：理解一個機制、比較幾個選項，或當場做一個工具。代理依任務選擇純文字、原生元件（A2UI 表格）或自訂互動 UI（串流進隔離 iframe 的 HTML／CSS／JS）。

正式畫面只有一頁聊天。這個展示頁把專案裡所有設計過的介面（含寫好但沒掛上的）用 fixture 資料攤開，並附上架構、串流契約、色彩系統與程式碼層面的解析。

這一份是 /gallery 的靜態重製版：不載入 React 與 CopilotKit，表格與數字在產生時從專案原始碼算出，互動樣本以 iframe 重播，需要代理後端的畫面以複刻或截圖呈現。每張卡片右上角的小標籤說明它在這裡是真品、複刻還是截圖。

請求流程

每一則新訊息先由 Jev（TypeSafe System One）做一次型別判斷，再由中介層過濾工具；回答模型只拿到對應 renderer 的契約。代理的 checkpoint 存在程序記憶體（BoundedMemorySaver，200 條 thread），重啟即失去對話。

三種回應模式

使用者任務回應形式前端渲染依據
快速事實、寫作、程式碼、閒聊直接文字CopilotChat 的 assistant message（AnswerMarkdown）docs/interactive-answers.md
基本表格、精確數值比較A2UI TabletableCatalog → DataTable（React 以文字渲染）components/generative-ui/table-catalog.tsx
理解機制或關係圖解或互動說明generateSandboxedUi → 隔離 iframeskills/svg-diagrams、advanced-visualization
比較選項表格、準則、取捨；必要時可調權重A2UI Table 或沙箱skills/master-playbook
做一個工具可用的輸入、計算、輸出與重設沙箱（calculator）skills/advanced-visualization

六欄位串流契約與渲染階段

代理必須依序輸出六個參數；渲染器用「CSS 先到才顯示」的門檻避免無樣式閃爍，再以預覽 iframe 逐段 morph，最後換成有橋接的 Websandbox。

#欄位代理端規則（prompt.py）渲染器行為（renderer.tsx）
1initialHeight預估完成後的高度（px）作為框架初始高度；之後由沙箱回報的 __ogui_resize 取代，限 50–4000px
2placeholderMessages2–4 則簡短進度訊息不在本地 schema 內，從未顯示；渲染器改用自己的 LOADING_PHRASES 每 1.8 秒輪播
3css所有樣式一次給齊cssComplete 之前只顯示 placeholder；完成後才建立預覽 iframe
4htmlbody 標記，不含 <style>/<script>逐段用 Idiomorph morph 進預覽 iframe（1 秒節流）；htmlComplete 後建立最終 Websandbox
5jsFunctions具名函式宣告最終沙箱就緒後注入一次
6jsExpressions小型同步敘述依到達順序逐條 await 執行；generating:false 後顯示匯出選單

02

設計方法

決策、約束、交付三層：每條規則對照原始檔案與頁內 demo

這個專案不是在設計一組介面，而是在設計一套讓模型在幾秒內生成介面的規則系統。介面設計拆成三層：決策層決定該出哪種介面，約束層規定介面必須長怎樣、怎麼動，交付層決定它怎麼在串流中出現。外面再包一層刻意極簡的聊天外殼。

每條規則都標出原始檔案，並連到這一頁裡對應的 demo；點「↓」會捲到該處。

決策層：介面類型怎麼被選出來

複刻已掛載

真正的視覺與互動設計不是畫出來的，是寫成模型能遵守的數字與契約：token 而非元件、幾何規格而非範例、互動與無障礙寫進同一份文件。

字體 system-ui 16px、行高 1.7；控制項 14px、36px 高、0.5px 邊框、8px 圓角；按鈕透明底細框
極低裝飾，視覺張力留給內容。
packages/design-system/src/index.ts FORM_STYLES_CSS同上 ↓
顏色一律角色 token，深色是另一組重新生成的值，絕不硬編 hexpackages/design-system/src/index.ts THEME_CSS · OPEN_GEN_UI_DESIGN_SKILL色彩學與配色 ↓
圖解幾何：viewBox 寬 680、安全區 40–640、箱高 44/56、箱距 ≥60、每列 ≤5 節點、字 14/12、字重 400/500、箭頭不穿箱、太複雜就拆圖、元素由上往下排讓串流自然建構apps/agent/skills/svg-diagrams/SKILL.md技能範例原文 ↓
色階是「淡底、深框、深字」三件組；一張圖只用 2–3 階；顏色對應意義不對應順序：暖色主動、冷色被動、灰色結構packages/design-system/src/index.ts SVG_CLASSES_CSS · skills/svg-diagrams/SKILL.md九色階兩種模式 ↓
互動是契約：每個啟用的控制都要真的運作；valueAsNumber、Number.isFinite、範圍與零除檢查；單位、假設、公式寫在 UI 裡；重設同步重設結果；排序保留篩選；外部文字只走 textContentapps/agent/src/prompt.py「Interaction and quality」· skills/advanced-visualization/SKILL.md readAmount帳單分攤 ↓

地圖專章：Leaflet 1.9.4、USGS 圖磚與可見 attribution、scrollWheelZoom 關閉、300/340px 高、照片要有來源與授權、連線標示「非駕駛路線」apps/agent/skills/advanced-visualization/SKILL.md「Live geographic maps」同上 ↓

交付層：介面怎麼被呈現

複刻已掛載

規則表：每列對照一個原始檔案與一個頁內 demo

串流本身就是設計決策。中介層把模型的 JSON token 切成事件，瀏覽器分三段畫：placeholder、預覽 iframe、最終沙箱；隔離決定了每個介面都是一張自足的卡片。

規則原始來源頁內對照
六欄位順序是為了觀感：CSS 先到所以不會出現無樣式畫面；html 在腳本到達前就可讀；行為最後到讓使用者看著功能逐一生效apps/agent/src/prompt.py「Streaming tool contract」· @copilotkit/runtime open-generative-ui-middleware串流重播的階段指示條 ↓
中介層扣住 TOOL_CALL_START 與 args 事件，等第一個 activity 事件發出才一起放行，RUN_FINISHED 延到下一個事件之後；JSON 解析錯誤只記 warning 然後 resume@copilotkit/runtime/dist/v2/runtime/open-generative-ui-middleware.mjs請求流程 ↓
渲染器外層每秒最多更新一次，但六種時刻立即放行：第一次 cssComplete、htmlComplete、generating 轉 false、第一次 jsFunctions、jsExpressions 增加、第一段 htmlapps/app/src/components/generative-ui/open-generative-ui/renderer.tsx shouldFlushImmediately、THROTTLE_MS重播時觀察節流 ↓
placeholder 只在 generating 且沒有可見沙箱時出現；高度用 initialHeight 或 200；七句詞每 1.8 秒輪換
代理輸出的 placeholderMessages 被本地 zod schema 當未知鍵剝掉，從未顯示。
apps/app/src/components/generative-ui/open-generative-ui/renderer.tsx LOADING_PHRASES載入中 placeholder ↓
預覽 iframe 要等 css 完成且清理後的 body 不是空白才建；清理五步：砍未閉合標籤、移除 style/script/head 區塊、移除未閉合區塊、砍未完成 entity、只取 body；Idiomorph morph，新節點加 morph-enterapps/app/src/components/generative-ui/open-generative-ui/process-partial-html.ts、frame-content.ts buildPreviewBodyMorph重播的 html 串流預覽階段 ↓
最終沙箱文件順序固定：CSP、importmap、createTripAnimator、design-system 三段 CSS、生成的 css、生成的 html；CSP 只允許四個 CDN 與 USGS、Wikimedia 圖片apps/app/src/components/generative-ui/open-generative-ui/frame-content.ts buildFinalFrameContent、CSP_META_TAGCDN 載入失敗時的可讀錯誤 ↓
jsFunctions 只注入一次、就緒前排隊；jsExpressions 用索引只跑新增的，逐條 await；高度由沙箱 ResizeObserver 回報，父頁只收自家 iframe 的訊息並夾在 50–4000pxapps/app/src/components/generative-ui/open-generative-ui/renderer.tsx、frame-content.ts MEASUREMENT_JS多條 jsExpressions 的範例 ↓
渲染器永遠用 ExportOverlay 包住框架，即使還在生成中：根節點一換 React 會重掛容器，正在運作的 iframe 會被無聲銷毀apps/app/src/components/generative-ui/open-generative-ui/renderer.tsx 末段註解匯出選單 ↓
隔離決定形狀：沙箱無儲存、無 fetch、無父頁存取，所以資料寫在 UI 裡、狀態只活在 iframe 裡，每次回答是一張快照apps/agent/src/prompt.py「Sandbox execution」· frame-content.ts每筆範例自足 ↓
sendPrompt 認領機制：iframe 呼叫經 Zod 驗證後在 window 派發事件，監聽者必須同步 claim；bridge 再驗一次、代理忙碌就拒絕、訂閱 RUN_ERROR、卸載時拒絕未完成的請求apps/app/src/lib/sandbox/sandbox-functions.ts、prompt-bridge.tsx展示頁的 stub 用同一個 claim 介面接住 ↓
原生元件：A2UI 表格是語意 table 加 caption、可聚焦橫向捲動、必填來源，值一律以文字渲染；HITL 卡只在 executing 顯示按鈕，使用者選擇以字串回到代理apps/app/src/components/generative-ui/table-catalog.tsx、meeting-time-picker.tsx排程卡三狀態 ↓
匯出走另一個組裝器：importmap、trip animator、design-system、css、一個 Websandbox stub，jsFunctions 放頂層、jsExpressions 包進 async IIFE；圖表匯出改用 UMD Chart.js 且不帶 CSPapps/app/src/components/generative-ui/export-utils.ts下載獨立 HTML ↓
外殼交付文字：Markdown 每個區塊進入視窗下緣 24px 內才淡入，MutationObserver 追串流新增；自動捲動關閉，只在送出新問題時把問題捲到頂端；複製鈕 hover 或 focus 才顯示apps/app/src/components/chat/reveal-blocks.ts、reader-scroll-view.tsx · apps/app/src/app/page.tsx嵌入的聊天外殼 ↓
金鑰閘門先攔下送出與建議、保留草稿、開對話框；儲存或清除金鑰會換 session key 重掛 CopilotKitapps/app/src/components/chat/key-gated-chat-view.tsx、provider-keys.tsx在外殼裡送出任何文字 ↓

交付層細節：從模型 token 到瀏覽器

欄位中介層解析時機發出的事件瀏覽器反應
initialHeight數值一到唯一一次 ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT：{initialHeight, generating:true}建一個該高度的 placeholder 框
placeholderMessages陣列開啟與每個元素/placeholderMessages 與逐項 append被本地 zod schema 剝掉，從未到渲染器
css整串字串結束後/css，再 /cssComplete:true之前只顯示 placeholder；之後才建預覽 iframe
html每次 write 後讀 clarinet 的 textNode 緩衝，有新字就發/html = [] 再逐段 append；結束時 /htmlComplete:true預覽 iframe 逐段 morph；完成後建最終沙箱
jsFunctions整串結束後/jsFunctions，再 /jsFunctionsComplete注入最終沙箱一次
jsExpressions每個元素逐項 append；陣列關閉時 /jsExpressionsComplete依序 await sandbox.run()
TOOL_CALL_END工具呼叫結束/generating:false顯示匯出選單
第一段：placeholder
條件：generating 且沒有任何可見沙箱
高度 initialHeight 或 200；12px 旋轉圈加一句每 1.8 秒輪換的詞。
第二段：預覽 iframe
條件：cssComplete 且清理後的 body 不是空白
沒有 localApi 的 Websandbox；head 寫入 overflow hidden、design-system、生成 css；body 用 Idiomorph morph，失敗退回 innerHTML；html 裡已完整的 <style> 會被抬到 head 當容錯。
第三段：最終沙箱
條件：htmlComplete
銷毀預覽、以完整文件建立帶 localApi 的 Websandbox；就緒後先跑量測腳本（ResizeObserver、前 3 秒每 200ms 回報）；再注入 jsFunctions、逐條執行 jsExpressions；generating:false 後顯示匯出選單。

與 MCP 舊軌道的差異

面向web 串流渲染器MCP assemble_document
輸入六欄位分開串流只收一個 html 字串
橋接Websandbox RPC，Zod 驗證，有回應與錯誤全域 window.sendPrompt 用 postMessage 送到 '*'，無驗證無回應
連結openLink 只允許 https，可設白名單攔截所有 http 開頭的 a[href] 點擊
高度ResizeObserver，前 3 秒每 200ms，父頁夾 50–4000#content.offsetHeight，15 秒內每 200ms
注入CSP、importmap、createTripAnimator、design-system、cssCSP、design-system；無 importmap、無 trip animator
CSP 圖片self、data、blob、USGS、Wikimediaself、data、blob（地圖圖磚會被擋）
入場動畫只在 initial-render 與 morph-enter#content 子元素永遠 stagger

評價

強項
  • 把設計系統壓縮成模型能遵守的數字與契約，而不是一份給人看的風格指南。
  • 串流優先：CSS 門檻、Idiomorph 預覽、常駐的匯出包裝，都是為了「邊生成邊可讀」。
  • 誠實標示與無障礙進了契約本文，不是附錄。
  • 型別判斷抽離成分類器並以工具過濾強制執行，可測、可審。
弱項
  • 規則與真實輸出之間沒有自動驗收：pytest 只驗文件彼此不矛盾，不驗產物。
  • 兩套視覺語言並存：沙箱用 design-system token，原生元件用 Tailwind 灰與藍。
  • placeholderMessages 被 zod 剝掉，提示要求的東西沒有畫面。
  • 1 秒節流讓短回答的預覽只更新一兩次，串流感主要來自那幾個立即放行點。
  • 最終沙箱的深色跟作業系統走，與 app 的主題切換脫節；連專案自己的 seed 範本都違反字重與硬編色規則。
03

設計系統

沙箱用的 token、表單控制項與 SVG 類別

沙箱裡的生成式 UI 只能用 packages/design-system/src/index.ts 提供的 token：背景、文字、邊框各三階，加上 info／danger／success／warning 四組語意色，以及字體與圓角。渲染器會把 THEME_CSS + SVG_CLASSES_CSS + FORM_STYLES_WITH_STAGGER_CSS 注入每個 iframe，所以 button、input、select 不用自己寫樣式。

這裡的色票與數值都是從匯出的 CSS 字串在產生時解析出來的，深色欄來自 @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) 區塊。

04

色彩學與配色

色彩家族、OKLCH、WCAG 對比、圖表與警示色

這個專案同時存在五個色彩家族：沙箱用的 design-system 語意 token、SVG 九色階、app 的品牌 lilac／mint 與 Tailwind 灰階、七色 CHART_COLORS，以及散落在十幾個檔案裡的硬編碼值。下面用 OKLCH 把它們放到同一個座標系，用 WCAG 2.2 AA 的嚴格門檻算對比，再用色盲模擬與 dataviz 驗證腳本檢查圖表色。所有數字都在頁面上即時計算。

方法論：三層 token（primitive → semantic → component，應用程式只碰 semantic）、主色用公式延伸而不是憑感覺、對比是生成參數不是事後檢查、色彩疲勞管的是 60-30-10 配額、警示色與圖表色在 semantic 層分家。

淺色值與深色值都在產生期算好；色相環、對比矩陣、品牌色對比與警示色各自用「淺色／深色」分段切換，數字與原頁即時計算的結果相同。

2 · 色相環：三套系統彼此不對齊

OKLCH 極座標分佈

產生期計算已掛載

color-components/hue-wheel.tsx（即時計算）

點越靠外 chroma 越高；點的大小隨明度放大。接近中心的點是中性色，看它們偏向哪個角度，就知道灰階帶的是哪一種色調。

點越靠外 chroma 越高；點的大小隨明度放大。接近中心的點是中性色，看它們偏向哪個角度，就知道灰階帶的是哪一種色調。

品牌 lilac 在 281°、mint 在 167°–180°；design-system 的 info 藍在 255° 附近、CHART_COLORS 的 blue 在 262°、purple 在 293°——同一個「藍」有三種角度。design-system 的灰（淺 #f7f6f3，L 0.97 · C 0.00 · H —；深 #2c2c2a，L 0.29 · C 0.00 · H —）是帶暖調的灰；app 的 Tailwind 灰（淺 #6b7280，L 0.55 · C 0.02 · H 264°；深 #9ca3af，L 0.71 · C 0.02 · H 261°）偏冷藍，兩套中性色方向相反。

  • 正常視覺最小 ΔEok×100：15.6（#E69F00 ↔ #D55E00）；dataviz 門檻 15

危險配對（classifyPair）：
  • blue ↔ purple：藍／紫配對且亮度相近（|ΔY| ≈ 0.04），紅色盲與綠色盲看不出紫色中的紅成分。
  • pink ↔ emerald：在綠色盲（deutan）模擬下兩色幾乎重疊（ΔE ≈ 0.049），且亮度相近（|ΔY| ≈ 0.12）。
  • pink ↔ orange：在藍色盲（tritan）模擬下兩色幾乎重疊（ΔE ≈ 0.041），且亮度相近（|ΔY| ≈ 0.08）。
  • emerald ↔ cyan：在藍色盲（tritan）模擬下兩色幾乎重疊（ΔE ≈ 0.034），且亮度相近（|ΔY| ≈ 0.02）。

專案的 bg + text + border 三件組正是 Carbon 的 low-contrast tint 結構，但沒有 high-contrast 層；錯誤橫幅用自己的 #ffac4d、QrModal 用 #e6a817／#1b936f，都沒走這組 token。

語意 hue 是否落在慣例範圍（±15°）：

淺色值：info 252°（慣例 藍 250°）在範圍內success 135°（慣例 綠 140°）在範圍內warning 64°（慣例 橙／琥珀 70°）在範圍內danger 25°（慣例 紅 25°）在範圍內

深色值：info 250°（慣例 藍 250°）在範圍內success 128°（慣例 綠 140°）在範圍內warning 71°（慣例 橙／琥珀 70°）在範圍內danger 20°（慣例 紅 25°）在範圍內

三重編碼檢查：DataTable 的無效列只有文字（缺 icon）；MeetingTimePicker 用 emoji 當 icon；QrModal 有色點 + 文字但色點太小。

7 · 色彩疲勞：60-30-10 配額

配額與頻率

已掛載

方法論：references/04-alerts-and-dataviz

60% 中性／背景30% 結構／邊框10%

10% 的高飽和預算由「警示」與「圖表重點色」共用。專案裡吃掉這份預算的東西：lilac→mint 漸層 CTA（cta-btn、TemplateCard Apply、CategoryFilter 作用態、DesktopTipModal 按鈕）、七色 CHART_COLORS、QrModal 狀態點、錯誤橫幅的橘框。疲勞來自面積 × 頻率，所以 toast 四秒自清、banner 同時只有一個，比選色更重要。

8 · 色彩建議清單（附取捨）

建議

拆 --brand 與 --primary

lilac-dark 對白底只有 2.72:1，當 CopilotKit primary 的文字／圖示色不達 3:1。保留它當品牌色（logo、CTA 漸層），另生一個 OKLCH L≈0.45、C≈0.10、H 281° 的互動主色。代價：多一個 token、按鈕沒那麼「淡紫」。

建議

統一一套 semantic 命名

刪掉 globals.css 與 design-system 重名的 --color-text-*；app 側改成 --surface-*／--text-*／--border-* 一套角色名，沙箱側維持 --color-*。代價：一次性搬 CSS。

建議

中性色帶主色調

app 的 Tailwind 灰偏冷藍（H≈260°）、design-system 灰偏暖（H≈90°），兩套看起來像拼裝。選一個 hue（建議 brand 的 281°），chroma 壓到 0.01–0.02 重生灰階。代價：灰階全換、視覺回歸要重拍。

建議

圖表色 token 化並固定順序

CHART_COLORS 改成 --chart-1..7 token、淺深兩套（深色降 chroma）；index % 7 循環改成「第 8 類折成 Other」；藍／紫相鄰對 ΔE 只有 12 要重新排序或換色。代價：三處複製要合併。

建議

警示色補 high-contrast 層

以 text 色當底、反白字，只給 modal／critical；.chat-error 與 QrModal 改用語意 token。代價：橘框顏色會變。

建議

硬編碼改 token、CI 擋 raw hex

399 處字面中，globals.css 之外約 278 處可逐步改成 var()；a2ui-theme.css 未引用可刪。CI 在 token build 時算對比，低於門檻 fail。代價：lint 初期會紅一片。

建議

沙箱深色跟 app 一致

THEME_CSS 除了 media query，再加 :root[data-theme=dark] 選擇器；渲染器建立 iframe 時把 app 的主題寫進去。代價：design-system 多一個選擇器、frame-content 多一行。

05

聊天外殼

正式畫面：標頭、CopilotChat、金鑰對話框、錯誤橫幅

正式畫面 apps/app/src/app/page.tsx 只有這幾樣東西：固定標頭、CopilotChat（歡迎畫面、四顆建議、輸入框）、金鑰對話框與錯誤橫幅。在 /gallery 裡，下面嵌的是同一個 CopilotKit provider 與同一條對話 thread，不是截圖；這份靜態版以複刻與本機截圖代替。

沒有金鑰時，送出訊息或點建議會被 KeyGatedChatView 攔下並打開對話框、保留草稿；這正是正式流程。沒有代理後端時，「Test connection」會回真實的錯誤訊息。

07

生成式 UI 範例

真實串流渲染器重播六欄位 payload

這一段在 /gallery 用正式的串流渲染器重播六欄位 payload：先看到 placeholder，css 到齊後出現預覽 iframe 逐段 morph，html 完成後換成有橋接的 Websandbox，再注入 jsFunctions 與逐條執行 jsExpressions。

靜態版把每筆樣本組成獨立 HTML 檔（與下載功能同一個組裝器：importmap、設計系統 CSS、css、html、jsFunctions 與 jsExpressions），在 sandbox iframe 裡載入；「重播串流」以三段 srcdoc／src 切換模擬串流節奏。每筆都能看原始 prompt 與四個程式欄位的原文。

repo 裡真正存在的輸出只有三份 seed 範本與技能文件裡的 SVG；帳單分攤、3D 飛機、海岸地圖等 launch 片段沒有留下輸出，所以這裡依技能規範重建，並明確標示。沙箱裡的「送出」按鈕會呼叫 Websandbox.connection.remote.sendPrompt；靜態版用 stub 接住並在框內顯示「模擬送出」，不會啟動代理。

依技能規範重建的示範，非代理實際輸出。示範「做一個工具」的完整形態：valueAsNumber＋Number.isFinite＋範圍驗證、aria-invalid、role=status 結果、整數分配零頭讓每人份額加總恰等於總額，以及按 master-playbook 寫法的 sendPrompt 追問按鈕（停用、await、錯誤可重試、finally 復原）。

原始使用者提示

Build a bill splitter with editable subtotal, tip percentage, and number of people. Show the total and each person's share, validate inputs, and allocate rounding cents so all shares sum to the exact total. Do not imply that any payment is sent.

initialHeight 520 · placeholderMessages 3 則
.bs { font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-text-primary); display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 560px; }
.bs h2 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; }
.bs-note { font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
.bs-grid { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 12rem), 1fr)); }
.bs-grid label { display: grid; gap: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
.bs-grid input { width: 100%; }
.bs-grid input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-border-danger); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-background-danger); }
.bs-readout { color: var(--color-text-primary); font-weight: 500; }
.bs-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.bs-result { padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg); background: var(--color-background-secondary); border: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary); }
.bs-summary { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; }
.bs-summary.is-error { color: var(--color-text-danger); }
.bs-shares { margin: 8px 0 0; padding-left: 22px; font-size: 14px; display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.bs-formula { font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-text-tertiary); font-family: var(--font-mono); line-height: 1.5; }
.bs-followup { font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); min-height: 1.4em; }
<section class="bs" aria-labelledby="bs-title">
  <h2 id="bs-title">Bill splitter</h2>
  <p class="bs-note">Enter the subtotal, choose a tip and the number of people. Every cent of the total is allocated. No payment is sent — this only calculates.</p>
  <div class="bs-grid">
    <label for="bs-subtotal">Subtotal (USD, 0–1,000,000)
      <input id="bs-subtotal" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="0" max="1000000" step="0.01" value="86.40">
    </label>
    <label for="bs-tip">Tip: <span class="bs-readout" id="bs-tip-out">18%</span>
      <input id="bs-tip" type="range" min="0" max="30" step="1" value="18">
    </label>
    <label for="bs-people">People (1–50)
      <input id="bs-people" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="50" step="1" value="4">
    </label>
  </div>
  <div class="bs-actions">
    <button type="button" onclick="resetSplit()">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" id="bs-ask" onclick="askAboutSplit(this)">Ask the agent about this split</button>
  </div>
  <p id="bs-followup" class="bs-followup" role="status"></p>
  <div class="bs-result" id="bs-result" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <p id="bs-summary" class="bs-summary">Enter values to see the split.</p>
    <ol id="bs-shares" class="bs-shares"></ol>
  </div>
  <p class="bs-formula">total = subtotal × (1 + tip ÷ 100), rounded to cents · base share = floor(total ÷ people) · leftover cents go one each to the first people in the list, so the shares always sum to the total.</p>
</section>
function readBillInput(id, min, max, message) {
  var input = document.getElementById(id);
  var value = input.valueAsNumber;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < min || value > max) {
    input.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    return { error: message };
  }
  input.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
  return { value: value };
}

function readBillInputs() {
  var subtotal = readBillInput("bs-subtotal", 0, 1000000, "Enter a subtotal from 0 to 1,000,000.");
  var tip = readBillInput("bs-tip", 0, 30, "Choose a tip from 0% to 30%.");
  var people = readBillInput("bs-people", 1, 50, "Enter a whole number of people from 1 to 50.");
  if (people.value !== undefined && !Number.isInteger(people.value)) {
    document.getElementById("bs-people").setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    people = { error: "People must be a whole number." };
  }
  var error = subtotal.error || tip.error || people.error;
  if (error) return { error: error };
  return { subtotal: subtotal.value, tip: tip.value, people: people.value };
}

function splitCents(totalCents, people) {
  var base = Math.floor(totalCents / people);
  var extra = totalCents - base * people;
  var shares = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < people; i += 1) shares.push(base + (i < extra ? 1 : 0));
  return shares;
}

function formatUsd(cents) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }).format(cents / 100);
}

function renderSplit() {
  var summary = document.getElementById("bs-summary");
  var list = document.getElementById("bs-shares");
  document.getElementById("bs-tip-out").textContent = document.getElementById("bs-tip").value + "%";
  list.textContent = "";
  var inputs = readBillInputs();
  if (inputs.error) {
    summary.textContent = inputs.error;
    summary.classList.add("is-error");
    return null;
  }
  summary.classList.remove("is-error");
  var subtotalCents = Math.round(inputs.subtotal * 100);
  var tipCents = Math.round(subtotalCents * inputs.tip / 100);
  var totalCents = subtotalCents + tipCents;
  var shares = splitCents(totalCents, inputs.people);
  summary.textContent = "Total " + formatUsd(totalCents) + " (subtotal " + formatUsd(subtotalCents) + " + tip " + formatUsd(tipCents) + ") split " + inputs.people + " ways:";
  shares.forEach(function (share, index) {
    var item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = "Person " + (index + 1) + ": " + formatUsd(share);
    list.appendChild(item);
  });
  return { totalCents: totalCents, shares: shares, inputs: inputs };
}

function resetSplit() {
  document.getElementById("bs-subtotal").value = "86.40";
  document.getElementById("bs-tip").value = "18";
  document.getElementById("bs-people").value = "4";
  document.getElementById("bs-followup").textContent = "";
  renderSplit();
}

async function askAboutSplit(button) {
  var status = document.getElementById("bs-followup");
  var result = renderSplit();
  if (!result) {
    status.textContent = "Fix the highlighted input first, then ask.";
    return;
  }
  button.disabled = true;
  status.textContent = "Sending question…";
  try {
    await Websandbox.connection.remote.sendPrompt({
      text: "In the bill splitter above the subtotal is " + formatUsd(Math.round(result.inputs.subtotal * 100)) +
        ", the tip is " + result.inputs.tip + "% and " + result.inputs.people + " people share a total of " +
        formatUsd(result.totalCents) + ". Explain whether this split is fair and suggest alternatives such as splitting by what each person ordered."
    });
    status.textContent = "Question sent.";
  } catch (error) {
    status.textContent = "Could not send. Please try again or type your question in chat.";
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
}

function initBillSplitter() {
  ["bs-subtotal", "bs-tip", "bs-people"].forEach(function (id) {
    document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("input", renderSplit);
  });
  renderSplit();
}
initBillSplitter();

  <p id="wk-reco" class="wk-reco" role="status">Move the sliders to score the three options.</p>
  <ul class="wk-list" id="wk-list">
    <li class="wk-item" data-key="coastal" data-cost="620" data-hours="2.5">
      <div class="wk-head"><span class="wk-name">Coastal</span><span class="wk-score" id="wk-score-coastal">—</span></div>
      <div class="wk-meta">Sample cost $620 · travel 2.5 h · beach walks, seafood, sunsets</div>
      <div class="wk-bar" aria-hidden="true"><div class="wk-fill" id="wk-fill-coastal"></div></div>
    </li>
    <li class="wk-item" data-key="city" data-cost="780" data-hours="1">
      <div class="wk-head"><span class="wk-name">City</span><span class="wk-score" id="wk-score-city">—</span></div>
      <div class="wk-meta">Sample cost $780 · travel 1 h · museums, restaurants, late nights</div>
      <div class="wk-bar" aria-hidden="true"><div class="wk-fill" id="wk-fill-city"></div></div>
    </li>
    <li class="wk-item" data-key="mountain" data-cost="540" data-hours="3.5">
      <div class="wk-head"><span class="wk-name">Mountain</span><span class="wk-score" id="wk-score-mountain">—</span></div>
      <div class="wk-meta">Sample cost $540 · travel 3.5 h · hiking, cabins, quiet</div>
      <div class="wk-bar" aria-hidden="true"><div class="wk-fill" id="wk-fill-mountain"></div></div>
    </li>
  </ul>
  <p class="wk-how" id="wk-how">How the recommendation changes: each option gets a cost score and a travel score between 0 and 100 (100 = best of the three, 0 = worst). The overall score is the weighted average of the two using your sliders. Push “budget” up and the cheapest option (Mountain) rises; push “short travel” up and the closest option (City) rises; Coastal wins when the two weights are balanced because it is second-best on both.</p>
</section>
function readWeekendOptions() {
  return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#wk-list .wk-item")).map(function (item) {
    return {
      key: item.dataset.key,
      name: item.querySelector(".wk-name").textContent,
      cost: Number(item.dataset.cost),
      hours: Number(item.dataset.hours),
      element: item
    };
  });
}

function normalizeLowerIsBetter(values) {
  var min = Math.min.apply(null, values);
  var max = Math.max.apply(null, values);
  return values.map(function (value) {
    return max === min ? 100 : Math.round(100 * (max - value) / (max - min));
  });
}

function scoreWeekend() {
  var budgetWeight = document.getElementById("wk-budget").valueAsNumber;
  var timeWeight = document.getElementById("wk-time").valueAsNumber;
  if (!Number.isFinite(budgetWeight)) budgetWeight = 0;
  if (!Number.isFinite(timeWeight)) timeWeight = 0;
  document.getElementById("wk-budget-out").textContent = String(budgetWeight);
  document.getElementById("wk-time-out").textContent = String(timeWeight);
  var options = readWeekendOptions();
  var costScores = normalizeLowerIsBetter(options.map(function (o) { return o.cost; }));
  var timeScores = normalizeLowerIsBetter(options.map(function (o) { return o.hours; }));
  var weightSum = budgetWeight + timeWeight;
  var reco = document.getElementById("wk-reco");
  var best = [];
  var bestScore = -1;
  options.forEach(function (option, index) {
    var score = weightSum === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((budgetWeight * costScores[index] + timeWeight * timeScores[index]) / weightSum);
    option.score = score;
    document.getElementById("wk-score-" + option.key).textContent = score + " / 100";
    document.getElementById("wk-fill-" + option.key).style.width = score + "%";
    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = [option]; }
    else if (score === bestScore) best.push(option);
  });
  options.forEach(function (option) {
    option.element.classList.toggle("is-top", weightSum > 0 && best.indexOf(option) !== -1);
  });
  if (weightSum === 0) {
    reco.textContent = "Both weights are 0, so nothing is being compared. Raise at least one slider.";
    return;
  }
  if (best.length > 1) {
    reco.textContent = "Tie between " + best.map(function (o) { return o.name; }).join(" and ") + " at " + bestScore + " / 100 with these weights.";
    return;
  }
  var top = best[0];
  var topIndex = options.indexOf(top);
  reco.textContent = "Recommendation: " + top.name + " (" + bestScore + " / 100) — cost score " + costScores[topIndex] + ", travel score " + timeScores[topIndex] + " with budget weight " + budgetWeight + " and travel weight " + timeWeight + ".";
}

function resetWeekend() {
  document.getElementById("wk-budget").value = "60";
  document.getElementById("wk-time").value = "40";
  scoreWeekend();
}

function initWeekend() {
  document.getElementById("wk-budget").addEventListener("input", scoreWeekend);
  document.getElementById("wk-time").addEventListener("input", scoreWeekend);
  scoreWeekend();
}
initWeekend();

Monty Hall simulation

另開完整頁

依技能規範重建的示範，非代理實際輸出。示範模擬型「理解」回答：主持人規則寫在畫面上、試驗次數驗證為 1–100,000 的整數、同一批隨機試驗同時計分「留」與「換」，表格把模擬勝率與理論機率放在不同欄位，絕不把模擬數字標成理論值。

原始使用者提示

Help me understand the Monty Hall problem with a simulation. Let me compare always staying versus always switching over repeated trials, explain the host's rules, and label simulated results separately from theoretical probabilities.

  1. placeholder（LOADING_PHRASES）

六欄位 payload 原文
initialHeight 460 · placeholderMessages 3 則
.mh { font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-text-primary); display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 600px; }
.mh h2 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; }
.mh p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
.mh-rules { padding-left: 20px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.mh-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: end; }
.mh-controls label { display: grid; gap: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); flex: 1 1 12rem; }
.mh-controls input { width: 100%; }
.mh-controls input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-border-danger); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-background-danger); }
.mh-status { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--border-radius-md); background: var(--color-background-secondary); font-size: 13px; }
.mh-status.is-error { background: var(--color-background-danger); color: var(--color-text-danger); }
.mh-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
.mh-table caption { text-align: left; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-text-tertiary); padding-bottom: 6px; }
.mh-table th, .mh-table td { text-align: left; padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary); }
.mh-table th { font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
.mh-table td.mh-sim { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--color-text-info); }
.mh-table td.mh-theory { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
.mh-why { font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-text-tertiary); line-height: 1.5; }
<section class="mh" aria-labelledby="mh-title">
  <h2 id="mh-title">Monty Hall: stay or switch?</h2>
  <p>Three doors hide one car and two goats. You pick a door, the host opens another, and you decide whether to keep your pick or switch. Run many trials to see which strategy wins more often.</p>
  <ol class="mh-rules">
    <li>The car is placed behind one of the three doors at random; you pick one door at random.</li>
    <li>The host knows where the car is and always opens a different door that hides a goat. If both other doors hide goats, the host picks one of them at random.</li>
    <li>“Stay” keeps your first door. “Switch” takes the one remaining closed door.</li>
  </ol>
  <div class="mh-controls">
    <label for="mh-trials">Trials (1–100,000; each trial is scored for both strategies)
      <input id="mh-trials" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="100000" step="1" value="1000">
    </label>
    <button type="button" onclick="runMonty()">Run simulation</button>
    <button type="button" onclick="resetMonty()">Reset</button>
  </div>
  <p id="mh-status" class="mh-status" role="status">No simulation run yet.</p>
  <table class="mh-table">
    <caption>Simulated win rates come from random trials in this page; theoretical probabilities are the exact values and do not change.</caption>
    <thead>
      <tr><th scope="col">Strategy</th><th scope="col">Simulated wins</th><th scope="col">Simulated win rate</th><th scope="col">Theoretical probability (exact)</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><th scope="row">Always stay</th><td class="mh-sim" id="mh-stay-wins">—</td><td class="mh-sim" id="mh-stay-rate">—</td><td class="mh-theory">1/3 ≈ 33.3%</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Always switch</th><td class="mh-sim" id="mh-switch-wins">—</td><td class="mh-sim" id="mh-switch-rate">—</td><td class="mh-theory">2/3 ≈ 66.7%</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  <p class="mh-why">Why switching wins: your first pick is right 1/3 of the time. The host’s reveal never moves the car, so the remaining closed door holds the other 2/3. Small trial counts fluctuate; the simulated rate approaches the theoretical value as trials grow, but it is never the same thing.</p>
</section>
function readTrials() {
  var input = document.getElementById("mh-trials");
  var status = document.getElementById("mh-status");
  var value = input.valueAsNumber;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || !Number.isInteger(value) || value < 1 || value > 100000) {
    input.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    status.textContent = "Enter a whole number of trials from 1 to 100,000.";
    status.classList.add("is-error");
    return null;
  }
  input.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
  status.classList.remove("is-error");
  return value;
}

function randomDoor() {
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
}

function hostOpens(car, pick) {
  var options = [0, 1, 2].filter(function (door) { return door !== car && door !== pick; });
  return options[Math.floor(Math.random() * options.length)];
}

function simulateMonty(trials) {
  var stayWins = 0;
  var switchWins = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < trials; i += 1) {
    var car = randomDoor();
    var pick = randomDoor();
    var opened = hostOpens(car, pick);
    var switched = [0, 1, 2].filter(function (door) { return door !== pick && door !== opened; })[0];
    if (pick === car) stayWins += 1;
    if (switched === car) switchWins += 1;
  }
  return { stayWins: stayWins, switchWins: switchWins };
}

function formatRate(wins, trials) {
  return (100 * wins / trials).toFixed(1) + "%";
}

function runMonty() {
  var trials = readTrials();
  if (trials === null) return;
  var result = simulateMonty(trials);
  var count = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US").format(trials);
  document.getElementById("mh-stay-wins").textContent = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US").format(result.stayWins);
  document.getElementById("mh-stay-rate").textContent = formatRate(result.stayWins, trials);
  document.getElementById("mh-switch-wins").textContent = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US").format(result.switchWins);
  document.getElementById("mh-switch-rate").textContent = formatRate(result.switchWins, trials);
  document.getElementById("mh-status").textContent = "Simulated " + count + " trials: stay won " + formatRate(result.stayWins, trials) + ", switch won " + formatRate(result.switchWins, trials) + " (simulated, random; theoretical values are in the last column).";
}

function resetMonty() {
  var input = document.getElementById("mh-trials");
  input.value = "1000";
  input.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
  ["mh-stay-wins", "mh-stay-rate", "mh-switch-wins", "mh-switch-rate"].forEach(function (id) {
    document.getElementById(id).textContent = "—";
  });
  var status = document.getElementById("mh-status");
  status.classList.remove("is-error");
  status.textContent = "No simulation run yet.";
}
resetMonty();

initialHeight 520 · placeholderMessages 3 則
.bg { font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-text-primary); display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 640px; }
.bg h2 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; }

<section class="bg" aria-labelledby="bg-title">
  <h2 id="bg-title">How bicycle gears work</h2>
  <p>The chain links the front chainring to a rear cog on the back wheel. One pedal turn pulls the chain by one chainring’s worth of teeth, so the cog — and the wheel bolted to it — turns <em>chainring teeth ÷ cog teeth</em> times. More front teeth or fewer rear teeth means a higher gear: further per pedal stroke, harder to push.</p>
  <div class="bg-controls">
    <label for="bg-front">Chainring teeth (24–56): <span class="bg-readout" id="bg-front-out">44</span>
      <input id="bg-front" type="range" min="24" max="56" step="1" value="44">
    </label>
    <label for="bg-rear">Rear cog teeth (10–36): <span class="bg-readout" id="bg-rear-out">16</span>
      <input id="bg-rear" type="range" min="10" max="36" step="1" value="16">
    </label>
    <div class="bg-actions">
      <button type="button" id="bg-pedal" onclick="pedalOnce()">Pedal once</button>
      <button type="button" onclick="resetGears()">Reset</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p id="bg-status" class="bg-status" role="status">Move the sliders to compute the gear ratio.</p>
  <svg class="bg-figure" width="100%" viewBox="0 0 680 330" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-labelledby="bg-svg-title bg-svg-desc">
    <title id="bg-svg-title">Chainring, chain and rear cog</title>
    <desc id="bg-svg-desc">Two circles sized by their tooth counts, joined by a dashed chain. Pressing “Pedal once” turns the chainring one full turn and the cog by the gear ratio; the dark marks show each part turning.</desc>
    <line id="bg-chain-top" class="bg-chain" x1="200" y1="76" x2="500" y2="130"/>
    <line id="bg-chain-bottom" class="bg-chain" x1="200" y1="244" x2="500" y2="190"/>
    <g id="bg-ring" class="bg-rot" data-angle="0">
      <circle id="bg-ring-circle" class="c-teal" cx="200" cy="160" r="84" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line id="bg-ring-mark" class="bg-mark" x1="200" y1="160" x2="200" y2="82"/>
    </g>
    <g id="bg-cog" class="bg-rot" data-angle="0">
      <circle id="bg-cog-circle" class="c-gray" cx="500" cy="160" r="30" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line id="bg-cog-mark" class="bg-mark" x1="500" y1="160" x2="500" y2="136"/>
    </g>
    <g class="c-teal">
      <text class="th" x="200" y="22" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">Chainring (front)</text>
      <text class="ts" id="bg-ring-label" x="200" y="40" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">44 teeth</text>
    </g>
    <g class="c-gray">
      <text class="th" x="500" y="22" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">Rear cog</text>
      <text class="ts" id="bg-cog-label" x="500" y="40" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">16 teeth</text>
    </g>
    <text class="ts" x="340" y="306" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">Dashed line = chain · dark marks show each part turning · sizes scale with tooth count</text>
  </svg>
  <ul class="bg-assume">
    <li>Simplified assumptions: a 700c road wheel (about 27 in / 2.1 m per wheel turn), no tyre-width or load effects.</li>
    <li>Gear inches = ratio × 27 in; metres per pedal turn = ratio × 2.1 m. Friction, derailleur chain wrap and cadence are ignored.</li>
  </ul>
</section>
function readTeeth(id, min, max) {
  var value = document.getElementById(id).valueAsNumber;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return null;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(value)));
}

function setAttrs(id, attrs) {
  var element = document.getElementById(id);
  Object.keys(attrs).forEach(function (name) { element.setAttribute(name, String(attrs[name])); });
}

function renderGears() {
  var front = readTeeth("bg-front", 24, 56);
  var rear = readTeeth("bg-rear", 10, 36);
  var status = document.getElementById("bg-status");
  if (front === null || rear === null) {
    status.textContent = "Choose tooth counts with the two sliders.";
    return null;
  }
  var ratio = front / rear;
  document.getElementById("bg-front-out").textContent = String(front);
  document.getElementById("bg-rear-out").textContent = String(rear);
  document.getElementById("bg-ring-label").textContent = front + " teeth";
  document.getElementById("bg-cog-label").textContent = rear + " teeth";
  var ringR = front * 1.9;
  var cogR = rear * 1.9;
  setAttrs("bg-ring-circle", { r: ringR });
  setAttrs("bg-ring-mark", { y2: 160 - ringR + 6 });
  setAttrs("bg-cog-circle", { r: cogR });
  setAttrs("bg-cog-mark", { y2: 160 - cogR + 6 });
  setAttrs("bg-chain-top", { y1: 160 - ringR, y2: 160 - cogR });
  setAttrs("bg-chain-bottom", { y1: 160 + ringR, y2: 160 + cogR });
  status.textContent = "Gear ratio " + front + " ÷ " + rear + " = " + ratio.toFixed(2) + ": one pedal turn = " + ratio.toFixed(2) + " wheel turns ≈ " + (ratio * 27).toFixed(0) + " gear inches ≈ " + (ratio * 2.1).toFixed(1) + " m of road (700c wheel assumed).";
  return ratio;
}

function pedalOnce() {
  var ratio = renderGears();
  if (ratio === null) return;
  var ring = document.getElementById("bg-ring");
  var cog = document.getElementById("bg-cog");
  var ringAngle = Number(ring.dataset.angle) + 360;
  var cogAngle = Number(cog.dataset.angle) + ratio * 360;
  ring.dataset.angle = String(ringAngle);
  cog.dataset.angle = String(cogAngle);
  ring.style.transform = "rotate(" + ringAngle + "deg)";
  cog.style.transform = "rotate(" + cogAngle + "deg)";
  var button = document.getElementById("bg-pedal");
  var reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  button.disabled = true;
  setTimeout(function () { button.disabled = false; }, reduced ? 0 : 1200);
}

function resetGears() {
  document.getElementById("bg-front").value = "44";
  document.getElementById("bg-rear").value = "16";
  ["bg-ring", "bg-cog"].forEach(function (id) {
    var group = document.getElementById(id);
    group.dataset.angle = "0";
    group.style.transform = "";
  });
  renderGears();
}

function initGears() {
  document.getElementById("bg-front").addEventListener("input", renderGears);
  document.getElementById("bg-rear").addEventListener("input", renderGears);
  renderGears();
}
initGears();

.cb h2 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; }

.cb-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; background: var(--color-background-warning); color: var(--color-text-warning); }
.cb-status { font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
.cb-chart { position: relative; height: 220px; padding: 8px; border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg); background: var(--color-background-secondary); border: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary); }
.cb-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
.cb-table caption { text-align: left; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-text-tertiary); padding-bottom: 6px; }
.cb-table th, .cb-table td { text-align: left; padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary); }
.cb-table th { font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
.cb-table td { font-family: var(--font-mono); }
<section class="cb" aria-labelledby="cb-title">
  <h2 id="cb-title">Cost per seat across three plan tiers</h2>
  <p class="cb-note"><span class="cb-tag">Illustrative sample numbers</span> These are made-up tiers to show the comparison, not any vendor’s price list. Replace the table values with real quotes before using them.</p>
  <p id="status" class="cb-status" role="status">Loading chart…</p>
  <div class="cb-chart"><canvas id="cb-canvas" role="img" aria-label="Bar chart of monthly cost per seat for Basic, Team and Business tiers; the same numbers are in the table below"></canvas></div>
  <table class="cb-table" id="cb-table">
    <caption>Same numbers as the chart (illustrative, USD per seat)</caption>
    <thead>
      <tr><th scope="col">Tier</th><th scope="col">Monthly per seat</th><th scope="col">Annual per seat (×12)</th><th scope="col">vs Basic</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><th scope="row">Basic</th><td data-value="8">$8</td><td>$96</td><td>—</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Team</th><td data-value="14">$14</td><td>$168</td><td>+$6 (+75%)</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Business</th><td data-value="22">$22</td><td>$264</td><td>+$14 (+175%)</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</section>
function chartToken(name) {
  return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
}

function readTierRows() {
  return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#cb-table tbody tr")).map(function (row) {
    return {
      label: row.querySelector("th").textContent.trim(),
      value: Number(row.querySelector("[data-value]").dataset.value)
    };
  });
}

async function setupChart() {
  var status = document.getElementById("status");
  var canvas = document.getElementById("cb-canvas");
  var rows = readTierRows();
  var chartModule = await import("chart.js/auto");
  var Chart = chartModule.default;
  var textColor = chartToken("--color-text-secondary");
  var gridColor = chartToken("--color-border-tertiary");
  var chart = new Chart(canvas, {
    type: "bar",
    data: {
      labels: rows.map(function (row) { return row.label; }),
      datasets: [{
        label: "Monthly cost per seat (USD, illustrative)",
        data: rows.map(function (row) { return row.value; }),
        backgroundColor: chartToken("--color-background-info"),
        borderColor: chartToken("--color-text-info"),
        borderWidth: 1.5,
        borderRadius: 4
      }]
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      animation: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? false : undefined,
      plugins: {
        legend: { labels: { color: textColor } },
        tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function (item) { return "$" + item.parsed.y + " per seat per month"; } } }
      },
      scales: {
        x: { ticks: { color: textColor }, grid: { display: false } },
        y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { color: textColor, callback: function (value) { return "$" + value; } }, grid: { color: gridColor } }
      }
    }
  });
  status.textContent = "Chart ready. The table below has the same numbers.";
  return chart;
}

function showChartError(error) {
  var status = document.getElementById("status");
  status.textContent = "The chart library could not load. The table below has the same numbers.";
  if (error && error.message) status.setAttribute("title", error.message);
}
setupChart().catch(showChartError);

Airplane pitch, roll and yaw

Jev 型別 interactive_diagram · 依技能規範重建需要 esm.sh

另開完整頁

依技能規範重建的示範，非代理實際輸出。示範 Three.js 場景：在 async 函式內 import 'three'、以設計代幣解析材質顏色、用盒體與圓柱拼出可辨認的飛機與三條機體軸線、手寫指標拖曳環繞相機、單一動畫迴圈、1.5 秒示範動畫（reduced-motion 直接跳轉）、WebGL 失敗顯示可讀訊息並停用控制項、pagehide 時釋放資源。

原始使用者提示

Create an interactive 3D airplane in Three.js that explains pitch, roll, and yaw. Make the airplane recognizable with a fuselage, wings, tail and cockpit, on a clean light background. Start with a three-quarter view. Give each axis a labeled slider with its angle and a button that smoothly demonstrates that motion, plus a Reset button. Show color-coded labeled axes through the plane: pitch raises or lowers the nose about the lateral axis, roll banks the wings about the longitudinal axis, and yaw turns the nose left or right about the vertical axis. Match each label, control and rotation correctly. Animate demonstrations over about 1.5 seconds, keep the camera stable during demonstrations, and let me drag to orbit the camera. Include one short explanation per axis. Keep the canvas compact enough that the controls are visible in chat. Respect reduced motion and show a readable error if WebGL cannot initialize. This is a conceptual rotation model, not a flight simulator.

在 Artifact 裡會被擋：importmap 指向 esm.sh，Artifact 的 CSP 會擋，只會看到樣本自己的錯誤狀態。下方的「本機畫面」是同一份樣本在本機 /gallery 的完成態。

按「重播串流」會依序顯示三段：placeholder 文字 → 只有 css＋html 的預覽 iframe → 帶腳本的完整頁；按「直接顯示完成版」立刻載入完整頁。這裡的 iframe 是這一頁附帶的獨立 HTML，與專案的匯出器（ExportOverlay）同一個組裝器產生。

  1. placeholder（LOADING_PHRASES）
  2. css 完成 → 可顯示
  3. html 串流預覽（Idiomorph）
  4. htmlComplete → 最終沙箱
  5. jsFunctions 注入
  6. jsExpressions 依序執行
  7. generating:false → 可匯出
靜態重播只能模擬前三段與最後一段：真正的 Idiomorph morph、jsFunctions 注入與逐條 jsExpressions 需要正式渲染器。

六欄位 payload 原文
initialHeight 560 · placeholderMessages 3 則

.ap-term { color: var(--color-text-primary); font-weight: 500; }

<section class="ap" aria-labelledby="ap-title">
  <h2 id="ap-title">Pitch, roll and yaw</h2>
  <ul class="ap-axes">

    <li><span class="ap-swatch ap-yaw" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ap-term">Yaw</span> — the nose turns left or right. Rotation about the vertical axis, the blue line through the plane top to bottom.</li>
  </ul>

    </div>

      <label for="ap-roll">Roll: <span class="ap-out" id="ap-roll-out">0°</span> (−45 to 45°)</label>
      <input id="ap-roll" type="range" min="-45" max="45" step="1" value="0" data-axis="roll">

    </div>

function planeToken(name, fallback) {
  var value = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
  return value || fallback;
}

function easeInOut(t) {
  return t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2;
}

function buildPlane(THREE, colors) {
  var group = new THREE.Group();
  function part(geometry, color, x, y, z) {
    var mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: color, roughness: 0.6 }));
    mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
    group.add(mesh);
    return mesh;
  }
  part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.28, 3.2, 24), colors.body, 0, 0, 0).rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
  part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.28, 24, 16), colors.body, 1.6, 0, 0);
  part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.2, 20, 12), colors.cockpit, 0.8, 0.22, 0).scale.set(1.8, 0.7, 1);
  part(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.7, 0.06, 3.8), colors.wing, 0.1, 0, 0);
  part(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, 0.05, 1.4), colors.wing, -1.45, 0, 0);
  part(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.45, 0.8, 0.05), colors.wing, -1.45, 0.4, 0);
  return group;
}

function axisLine(THREE, x, y, z, color) {
  var points = [new THREE.Vector3(-x, -y, -z), new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z)];
  return new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points), new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: color }));
}

async function setupScene() {
  var status = document.getElementById("status");
  var host = document.getElementById("ap-canvas");
  var THREE = await import("three");
  var renderer;
  try {
    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error("WebGL could not initialize in this browser");
  }
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
  host.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
  var scene = new THREE.Scene();
  scene.background = new THREE.Color(planeToken("--color-background-secondary", "whitesmoke"));
  scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight("white", "gray", 1.1));
  var sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight("white", 1.4);
  sun.position.set(4, 6, 3);
  scene.add(sun);
  var colors = {
    body: planeToken("--color-text-tertiary", "silver"),
    wing: planeToken("--color-text-secondary", "gray"),
    cockpit: planeToken("--color-text-info", "steelblue"),
    pitch: planeToken("--color-text-danger", "crimson"),
    roll: planeToken("--color-text-success", "seagreen"),
    yaw: planeToken("--color-text-info", "steelblue")
  };
  var plane = buildPlane(THREE, colors);
  plane.rotation.order = "YZX";
  plane.add(axisLine(THREE, 0, 0, 2.6, colors.pitch));
  plane.add(axisLine(THREE, 2.6, 0, 0, colors.roll));
  plane.add(axisLine(THREE, 0, 2, 0, colors.yaw));
  scene.add(plane);
  var camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(40, 1, 0.1, 100);
  var orbit = { theta: 0.7, phi: 1.05, radius: 7.5 };
  function placeCamera() {
    camera.position.set(
      orbit.radius * Math.sin(orbit.phi) * Math.sin(orbit.theta),
      orbit.radius * Math.cos(orbit.phi),
      orbit.radius * Math.sin(orbit.phi) * Math.cos(orbit.theta));
    camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
  }
  var axes = ["pitch", "roll", "yaw"];
  var angles = { pitch: 0, roll: 0, yaw: 0 };
  var reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  var tween = null;
  var frameId = 0;
  function applyAngles() {
    var rad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad;
    plane.rotation.set(-rad(angles.roll), rad(angles.yaw), rad(angles.pitch));
    axes.forEach(function (axis) {
      document.getElementById("ap-" + axis).value = String(Math.round(angles[axis]));
      document.getElementById("ap-" + axis + "-out").textContent = Math.round(angles[axis]) + "°";
    });
  }
  function demonstrate(axis) {
    if (reduced) {
      angles[axis] = 30;
      applyAngles();
      status.textContent = "Reduced motion: showing " + axis + " at 30° without animation. Use the slider or Reset to change it.";
      return;
    }
    tween = { axis: axis, from: angles[axis], start: performance.now(), duration: 1500 };
    status.textContent = "Demonstrating " + axis + "…";
  }
  function resetAll() {
    orbit.theta = 0.7;
    orbit.phi = 1.05;
    placeCamera();
    if (reduced) {
      angles = { pitch: 0, roll: 0, yaw: 0 };
      applyAngles();
    } else {
      tween = { axis: "all", from: { pitch: angles.pitch, roll: angles.roll, yaw: angles.yaw }, start: performance.now(), duration: 1500 };
    }
    status.textContent = "Reset to level flight and the three-quarter view.";
  }
  function step(now) {
    if (tween) {
      var t = Math.min(1, (now - tween.start) / tween.duration);
      var eased = easeInOut(t);
      if (tween.axis === "all") {
        axes.forEach(function (axis) { angles[axis] = tween.from[axis] * (1 - eased); });
      } else {
        angles[tween.axis] = tween.from + 35 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * eased);
      }
      applyAngles();
      if (t >= 1) {
        tween = null;
        status.textContent = "Drag to orbit the camera; use the sliders or Demonstrate buttons.";
      }
    }
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    frameId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  function resize() {
    var width = host.clientWidth || 320;
    var height = host.clientHeight || 260;
    renderer.setSize(width, height);
    camera.aspect = width / height;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }
  var drag = null;
  var canvas = renderer.domElement;
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (event) {
    drag = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
    canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", function (event) {
    if (!drag) return;
    orbit.theta -= (event.clientX - drag.x) * 0.01;
    orbit.phi = Math.min(2.6, Math.max(0.4, orbit.phi - (event.clientY - drag.y) * 0.01));
    drag = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
    placeCamera();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", function () { drag = null; });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", function () { drag = null; });
  axes.forEach(function (axis) {
    document.getElementById("ap-" + axis).addEventListener("input", function (event) {
      tween = null;
      var value = event.target.valueAsNumber;
      angles[axis] = Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.max(-45, Math.min(45, value)) : 0;
      applyAngles();
    });
  });
  Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-demo]")).forEach(function (button) {
    button.addEventListener("click", function () { demonstrate(button.dataset.demo); });
  });
  document.getElementById("ap-reset").addEventListener("click", resetAll);
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(host);
  window.addEventListener("pagehide", function () {
    cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
    scene.traverse(function (object) {
      if (object.geometry) object.geometry.dispose();
      if (object.material) object.material.dispose();
    });
    renderer.dispose();
  });
  resize();
  placeCamera();
  applyAngles();
  status.textContent = "Drag to orbit the camera; use the sliders or Demonstrate buttons.";
  frameId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
}

function showSceneError(error) {
  var status = document.getElementById("status");
  var reason = error && error.message ? error.message : "unknown error";
  status.textContent = "The 3D scene could not load (" + reason + "). The explanation above still applies.";
  Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".ap-controls input, .ap-controls button")).forEach(function (control) {
    control.disabled = true;
  });
}
setupScene().catch(showSceneError);

Coastal trip pin drops

另開完整頁

依技能規範重建的示範，非代理實際輸出。示範 advanced-visualization 技能的行程地圖寫法：以 script 元素載入 Leaflet 1.9.4、fetch 樣式文字塞進 style 元素、USGS 地形圖磚與可見出處、編號 divIcon 內層 .pin-dot 交給 window.createTripAnimator 逐一落釘並揭露連線、文字卡片列、Pause／Resume／Replay、第一張圖磚載入後才開始，圖磚或函式庫失敗都有可讀狀態。

Plan an illustrative four-day coastal trip from San Francisco to Los Angeles, stopping at Half Moon Bay, Santa Cruz, Monterey, and Santa Barbara. Show a real map with numbered pins and photo cards. Reveal connecting segments behind the pins and highlight the corresponding card. Keep the map camera still; do not animate a traveler along the route. Include pause, replay and clickable stop cards. Use live USGS tiles and sourced photos; label the connecting line as an itinerary sketch, not verified driving directions.

async function loadLeaflet() {
  if (window.L) return window.L;
  var cssResponse = await fetch("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css");
  if (!cssResponse.ok) throw new Error("Leaflet stylesheet failed with status " + cssResponse.status);
  var style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = await cssResponse.text();
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  await new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
    var script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js";
    script.onload = resolve;
    script.onerror = function () { reject(new Error("Leaflet script could not be loaded")); };
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });
  return window.L;
}

function connectTour(points, routeLine, pinElements, activateStop, reportState) {
  return window.createTripAnimator({
    stopCount: points.length,
    durationMs: 6000,
    pinElements: pinElements,
    onFrame: function (frame) {
      var count = frame.pinIndex + (frame.pinProgress >= 0.7 ? 1 : 0);
      routeLine.setLatLngs(points.slice(0, count));
      activateStop(frame.activeStop);
    },
    onState: reportState
  });
}

function showTripError(error) {
  var status = document.getElementById("tr-status");
  var reason = error && error.message ? error.message : "unknown error";
  status.textContent = "The map could not load (" + reason + "). The stop list below still describes the itinerary.";
  status.classList.add("is-error");
}

async function setupTrip() {
  var status = document.getElementById("tr-status");
  var strip = document.getElementById("tr-strip");
  var cards = Array.from(strip.querySelectorAll(".tr-card"));
  var points = cards.map(function (card) { return [Number(card.dataset.lat), Number(card.dataset.lng)]; });
  var pauseButton = document.getElementById("tr-pause");
  var replayButton = document.getElementById("tr-replay");
  if (typeof window.createTripAnimator !== "function") throw new Error("trip animator helper is not installed");
  var L = await loadLeaflet();
  status.textContent = "Waiting for the first basemap tile…";
  var map = L.map("tr-map", { scrollWheelZoom: false });
  var tiles = L.tileLayer("https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSTopo/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", {
    maxNativeZoom: 16,
    maxZoom: 18,
    attribution: '<a href="https://www.usgs.gov/programs/national-geospatial-program/national-map">USGS The National Map</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  var accent = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--color-text-info").trim();
  var routeLine = L.polyline([], { color: accent, weight: 2, dashArray: "6 6" }).addTo(map);
  var pinElements = points.map(function (latlng, index) {
    var icon = L.divIcon({ className: "tr-pin", html: '<span class="pin-dot">' + (index + 1) + '</span>', iconSize: [28, 28], iconAnchor: [14, 14] });
    var marker = L.marker(latlng, { icon: icon, keyboard: false }).addTo(map);
    marker.on("click", function () { jumpTo(index); });
    return marker.getElement().querySelector(".pin-dot");
  });
  map.fitBounds(L.latLngBounds(points), { padding: [28, 28] });
  map.invalidateSize();
  var activeIndex = -1;
  var state = "paused";
  var controller = null;
  var started = false;
  function activateStop(index) {
    if (index === activeIndex) return;
    activeIndex = index;
    cards.forEach(function (card, i) {
      if (i === index) card.setAttribute("aria-current", "step"); else card.removeAttribute("aria-current");
      pinElements[i].classList.toggle("is-active", i === index);
    });
    var card = cards[index];
    var maxScroll = Math.max(0, strip.scrollWidth - strip.clientWidth);
    strip.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxScroll, card.offsetLeft - strip.offsetLeft));
    if (started) status.textContent = "Stop " + (index + 1) + " of " + points.length + ": " + card.querySelector(".tr-name").textContent + " (" + card.querySelector(".tr-day").textContent + ").";
  }
  function reportState(next) {
    state = next;
    pauseButton.textContent = next === "playing" ? "Pause" : "Resume";
    pauseButton.disabled = next === "complete";
    replayButton.disabled = false;
  }
  function jumpTo(index) {
    if (!controller) return;
    controller.seek(index);
    map.panTo(points[index], { animate: !window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches });
  }
  cards.forEach(function (card, index) {
    card.addEventListener("click", function () { jumpTo(index); });
  });
  controller = connectTour(points, routeLine, pinElements, activateStop, reportState);
  pauseButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (state === "playing") controller.pause(); else controller.play();
  });
  replayButton.addEventListener("click", function () { controller.replay(); });
  tiles.once("tileload", function () {
    started = true;
    status.classList.remove("is-error");
    status.textContent = "Basemap loaded. Pinning the stops one by one…";
    controller.play();
  });
  tiles.on("tileerror", function () {
    if (started) return;
    status.textContent = "Basemap tiles are not loading right now (the USGS service is best-effort). The stop list below still describes the itinerary.";
    status.classList.add("is-error");
  });
}
setupTrip().catch(showTripError);

材料集合

模型能從哪些集合裡挑：A2UI 基本目錄 18 個元件實渲染、專案目錄、Controlled 元件、沙箱材料、技能與工具

「從集合挑」和「當場設計」是兩種不同的生成方式。這一區把專案裡每一個可供模型挑選的集合攤開：它在哪個檔案、有幾件材料、誰在什麼時候挑、有沒有接上線。其中 A2UI v0.9 基本目錄的 18 個元件在 /gallery 用套件內建的 basicCatalog 真實渲染；靜態版放的是那三個 surface 的截圖與完整的訊息 JSON，正式對話裡只有 Table 一個元件會出現。

A2UI 的排版只有 justify、align、weight 這類提示，沒有像素也沒有顏色；沙箱材料則相反，顏色與控制項樣式固定，版面由模型當場寫。

集合索引

複刻已掛載

每列對照一個原始檔案與一個頁內 demo；接線狀態依 providers.tsx、main.py 與 runtime options 判定

集合材料數來源誰挑、何時挑接線頁內
A2UI v0.9 基本目錄（basicCatalog）18 元件 · 14 個 schema 函式（runtime 另 11 個）· 59 個 icon 名稱@a2ui/web_core/v0_9/schemas/basic_catalog.json · @copilotkit/a2ui-renderergenerate_a2ui 的次級模型從目錄點名元件、排巢狀、給版面提示未接線套件隨 app 安裝，但 provider 只掛 tableCatalog；這一頁是它在專案裡第一次被完整畫出來實渲染 18 個元件 ↓
A2UI v0.8 標準目錄18 元件（MultipleChoice 取代 ChoicePicker）@a2ui/web_core/v0_8/schemas/standard_catalog_definition.json · apps/agent/src/form.pygenerate_form 工具以手寫固定 schema 組登入卡，模型只決定要不要呼叫未接線0.8 信封與巢狀寫法，0.9 渲染器不認；前端也刻意忽略 generate_form0.8 vs 0.9 對照 ↓
專案 A2UI 目錄 tableCatalog1 元件（Table）apps/app/src/components/generative-ui/table-catalog.tsxJev 判為 table 後，render_a2ui 只填 title、columns、rows、source已接線正式對話唯一會畫出來的 A2UI 元件看表格 ↓
Controlled 元件（前端工具）4 個有 UI · 1 個無 UI · 1 個預設渲染apps/app/src/hooks/use-generative-ui-examples.tsx主模型選工具並填參數；Jev 路由時剔除 barChart、pieChart、generate_form部分接線元件掛著，但 Jev 開啟後圖表工具不會出現在模型面前對照表 ↓
沙箱材料（設計系統）27 token · 9 色階 · 7 個圖表輔助類別 · 4 個 CDN 函式庫packages/design-system/src/index.tsgenerateSandboxedUi 時由設計技能文字指示模型取用，版面仍由模型當場寫已接線THEME、FORM、SVG 三段 CSS 注入每個沙箱；importmap 提供 three、gsap、d3、chart.js材料清單 ↓
代理技能3 份技能 · 3 種圖型 · 6 個 SVG 元件模式apps/agent/skills/*/SKILL.md代理依 master-playbook 讀取；apps/mcp 也把同一批技能當 resource 提供已接線唯一以「模式」而非「元件」供模型挑選的集合技能與模式 ↓
Jev 視覺化型別13 型別 → 3 條渲染路線apps/agent/src/visualization_router.pyJev 路由模型先挑型別，再決定 text、A2UI 或沙箱已接線需要 TYPESAFE_API_KEY；這一步挑的是路線，不是版面路由表 ↓
代理工具6 個已註冊 · 5 個定義未註冊apps/agent/main.py · apps/agent/src/templates.py主模型工具選擇部分接線templates.py 的五個範本工具沒有進 tools 清單工具表 ↓
版面範本與示範提示3 份 seed 範本 · 7 條 demo 提示apps/app/src/components/template-library/seed-templates.ts · demo-gallery/demo-data.tspending_template state 與 DemoGallery 抽屜，兩者都沒有入口未接線專案裡唯一「從版面集合挑」的機制，設計了卻沒接上範本卡 ↓
MCP Apps 伺服器0 個（可選接頭）apps/app/src/lib/copilotkit-runtime-options.ts · apps/mcp/src/server.ts主模型選 MCP 工具；宿主抓伺服器預先宣告的 ui:// 模板外部只有設 MCP_SERVER_URL 才接；自家 apps/mcp 只註冊工具，沒有 ui:// 資源無 demo
Open Generative UI沒有集合：每次當場生成generateSandboxedUi（由 runtime 注入）模型當場寫 HTML、CSS、JS；只受技能與設計系統的文字規則約束已接線本專案主路徑；材料來自上面的「沙箱材料」與「代理技能」串流重播 ↓

A2UI v0.9 基本目錄：18 個元件

共有欄位：id、component、weight（spec 定義為 flex-grow 提示，只在 Row／Column 直接子元件生效；@copilotkit/a2ui-renderer 1.55.2 的 React 元件沒有實作它）。輸入元件的值一律綁到資料模型的 {path}；在本機 /gallery 按鈕的 action 會以 toast 顯示代理收到的事件（截圖裡底部的深色條）。

內容元件：Text、Image、Icon、Video、AudioPlayer

createSurface → updateDataModel → updateComponents；22 個扁平元件，root 為 Column

展示元件：Text、Image、Icon、Video、AudioPlayer、Column、Row

元件群組props模型能動的旋鈕
Text內容text: DynamicStringvariant: h1 · h2 · h3 · h4 · h5 · body · caption
Image內容url、descriptionfit: contain · cover · fill · none · scaleDown；variant: icon · avatar · smallFeature · mediumFeature · largeFeature · header
Icon內容name: 59 個固定名稱或 {path}無
Video內容url無
AudioPlayer內容url、description無
Row排版容器children: id[] 或 {componentId, path} 模板justify: start · center · end · spaceBetween · spaceAround · spaceEvenly · stretch；align: start · center · end · stretch
Column排版容器childrenjustify、align 同 Row，主軸改為垂直

Text 只有七個 variant，Image 只有六個尺寸等級與五種 fit；Icon 只能從 59 個名稱裡挑。渲染器輸出 material-symbols-outlined 的 span，沒有載入該字型，所以這裡把名稱以小標籤顯示；正式部署要自行載入 Material Symbols。最後一個 icon 綁到資料模型 /iconName。

截圖來自本機 /gallery 以 basicCatalog 真實渲染的畫面；下方 JSON 是餵給渲染器的完整訊息序列，可直接拿去任何 A2UI v0.9 渲染器重現。

排版容器：Row、Column、List、Card、Tabs、Modal、Divider 與版面旋鈕

模型能動的只有 justify、align、weight、direction、axis 這幾個提示；間距、邊框、陰影都是渲染器寫死的，Card 一律撐滿寬度，weight 在這版 React 渲染器裡沒有對應的 flex-grow。children 也可以是 {componentId, path} 模板，從資料模型展開成清單。按鈕點了會以 toast 顯示 action。

展示元件：TextField、CheckBox、ChoicePicker、Slider、DateTimeInput、Button、Text、Column、Row

元件群組props模型能動的旋鈕
Text內容text: DynamicStringvariant: h1 · h2 · h3 · h4 · h5 · body · caption
Row排版容器children: id[] 或 {componentId, path} 模板justify: start · center · end · spaceBetween · spaceAround · spaceEvenly · stretch；align: start · center · end · stretch
Column排版容器childrenjustify、align 同 Row，主軸改為垂直
Button輸入與動作child、action: {event:{name, context}} 或 {functionCall}variant: default · primary · borderless
TextField輸入與動作label、value: {path}、validationRegexp、checksvariant: shortText · longText · number · obscured
CheckBox輸入與動作label、value: {path}、checks無
ChoicePicker輸入與動作label、options: [{label, value}]、value: {path}variant: mutuallyExclusive · multipleSelection；displayStyle: checkbox · chips；filterable
Slider輸入與動作label、min、max、value: {path}無
DateTimeInput輸入與動作label、value: {path}、min、maxenableDate、enableTime

每個輸入都綁到資料模型的 {path}；下方的 Text 用 formatString、pluralize 即時讀同一份資料。Email 欄位掛了 checks: email() 驗證。按 Primary 會把 context 裡的綁定值一起送出，頁面上以 toast 顯示代理會收到的 action。

截圖來自本機 /gallery 以 basicCatalog 真實渲染的畫面；下方 JSON 是餵給渲染器的完整訊息序列，可直接拿去任何 A2UI v0.9 渲染器重現。

14 個 client 函式

複刻未掛載

BASIC_FUNCTIONS · @a2ui/web_core/v0_9/basic_catalog

寫在 DynamicValue 的 {call, args, returnType}，或 checks: [{condition, message}]；輸入 surface 實際用了 email、formatString、pluralize、formatCurrency、openUrl

函式角色args
required驗證value
regex驗證value、pattern
length驗證value、min／max
numeric驗證value、min／max
email驗證value
formatString格式化value（含 ${/path} 與 ${fn()} 插值）
formatNumber格式化value、decimals、grouping
formatCurrency格式化value、currency、decimals
formatDate格式化value、format（TR35 樣式）
pluralize格式化value、zero／one／two／few／many／other
and邏輯values[]
or邏輯values[]
not邏輯value
openUrl動作url

schema 只公開這 14 個；安裝的 runtime 另實作 11 個沒寫進 schema 的函式（add、subtract、multiply、divide、equals、not_equals、greater_than、less_than、contains、starts_with、ends_with），模型照 schema 不會知道它們存在。

generate_form · apps/agent/src/form.py · @a2ui/web_core/v0_8 · @a2ui/web_core/v0_9

v0.8 的 18 個元件與 v0.9 幾乎同名，差別在信封、寫法與旋鈕；form.py 的每一項都落在 0.8 那一欄

面向v0.8v0.9（app 渲染器）form.py 實際
訊息信封surfaceUpdate · dataModelUpdate · beginRenderingcreateSurface · updateComponents · updateDataModel · deleteSurfacesurfaceUpdate + beginRendering
元件寫法巢狀：{ id, component: { Card: { child } } }扁平：{ id, component: "Card", child }巢狀
排版旋鈕Column／Row 用 alignment、distributionjustify、align（對應 flex 的 justify-content、align-items）alignment: center、distribution: center
文字樣式Text.usageHint: h1 … captionText.variantusageHint: h2、caption
選項元件MultipleChoiceChoicePicker（variant + displayStyle + filterable）未用到
根節點beginRendering.root 指定 id元件 id 必須是 rootroot: "root"
目錄固定標準目錄createSurface.catalogId 必填，可自訂目錄未用到
主題beginRendering.stylescreateSurface.theme：primaryColor、iconUrl、agentDisplayName未用到
資料綁定{ path }{ path } 不變；另加 client 函式 {call, args, returnType} 與 checks 驗證未用到

v0.8 元件：AudioPlayer、Button、Card、CheckBox、Column、DateTimeInput、Divider、Icon、Image、List、Modal、MultipleChoice、Row、Slider、Tabs、Text、TextField、Video。v0.9 把 MultipleChoice 換成 ChoicePicker，其餘 17 個名稱不變。
